decks.description: Three-rod bar (CROD); DMAP ALTER prints KGGX and exits before the solve
notes: The DMAP ALTER prints the global stiffness KGGX (MATPRN) and then `JUMP FINIS`, so the listing has no displacements; KGGX is the CROD stiffness reference.
The ALTER deliberately contains erroneous PARAML/PARAMR/PARAMD calls (marked INTENTIONAL ERROR in the deck).
